احماررت (form XI)
# اِحْمَارَرْتُ (iḥmārartu) /iħ.maː.rar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِحْمَارَّ (iḥmārra)
# اِحْمَارَرْتَ (iḥmārarta) /iħ.maː.rar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِحْمَارَّ (iḥmārra)
# اِحْمَارَرْتِ (iḥmārarti) /iħ.maː.rar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِحْمَارَّ (iḥmārra)
